newsitem.title: USA: Unocal plans January outage for Calif. coker.
newsitem.headline: Unocal plans January outage for Calif. coker.

text.p: Unocal Corp plans to shut a coker at its Los Angeles-area refinery in January for about 10 days of planned maintenance, a source familiar with refinery operations said.
"Right now its scheduled for January but it could be moved," back to February, the industry source said.
The refinery can process about 105,000 barrels per day of crude, while the coker runs around 50,000 bpd.
The maintenance will leave extra San Joaquin Valley and Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) crudes in the West Coast market, the source said.
